title: Go-to-market demo strip: sequenced product screenshots and annotated assets for sales quickstart
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a new sequenced screenshot strip and annotated asset pack for the sales quickstart deck used in GTM presentations. This ticket covers: (1) hero strip (one long horizontal composition) that visually communicates 'Onboard in 3 steps' using production screenshots; (2) three step-by-step frames (desktop + mobile variants) that show: project creation, model selection & routing settings, and first inference response streaming; (3) annotated callouts and 1-line captions for each frame for use on the slide and accompanying one-pager; (4) exported PNGs and SVG icons plus Figma source file organized in a dedicated page; (5) accessibility alt-text and short copy for localization. Avoid reusing exact language and visual patterns from prior quickstart decks—this should read and look distinct, with a cleaner, left-aligned layout and a progressive motion suggestion for the deck animator.
acceptance_criteria: Hero horizontal strip exported as PNG 3200x700 @2x and an editable SVG source
Three sequenced frames exported for desktop (1600x900) and mobile (640x360) each with seperate caption text files
Figma page with named frames, components, and an 'exports' frame containing final assets
Annotated PDF (A4) with callouts mapped to product features and suggested speaker notes
All assets uploaded to the sales-assets Drive folder and linked from this ticket
Sign-off from Sales PM (Miguel Santos) and Product (Ravi Singh) in comments
export_specs: Hero: PNG 3200x700 @2x, SVG (editable, preserve text as outlines option off)
Step frames desktop: 1600x900 PNG @1x and @2x for retina
Icons: SVG 24x24 and 48x48, provide optimized PNG fallback
Caption files: plain text UTF-8 with suggested alt-text / localization keys
